foliage:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production diffuse/albedo foliage sprite atlas for a small oak branch in Blender and Godot.
Reference image is ONLY the approved painting direction, not an edit target. Generate a NEW square RGBA texture atlas on genuinely transparent background, no board, no labels, no shadows or background plane.
Exactly FOUR separate face-on broad oak leaves, one centered in each quadrant of a clean equal 2x2 grid. Every leaf points straight up; a short petiole ends at bottom center of its quadrant. No rotations, twigs or overlapping sprites. Keep the whole leaf inside its quadrant, with at least 8 percent transparent margin on every side and generous separation. Each blade broad with softly rounded oak lobes, not sharp maple points, not a spear or pine needles. All four leaves have comparable silhouette and size.
Match the reference's beautiful hand-painted broad confident gouache brush strokes, matte surfaces, large readable color shapes and restrained yellow-olive central and secondary veins. Four cohesive variants: warm oak green, olive with golden green accents, slightly cooler sage olive, rich deep green with soft olive strokes. Natural saturation, no neon chartreuse, no pure white veins, no black baked shadows, no specular shine, no photographic microtexture. Paint with flat diffuse neutral illumination so the game engine supplies lighting. Preserve clear beautiful handmade surface texture visible close up. The leaf sprites themselves are opaque except for genuinely transparent cutout background. No text, watermark, acorns, stems connecting different sprites or scenery.
